save_checkpoint_accelerator_state: save the states of models, optimizers, schedulers, dataloaders, scaler, and RNG generators to a directory
load_checkpoint_accelerator_state: load model, optimizer, scheduler, dataloader, scaler, and RNG states from a checkpoint directory
save_custom_state: save the state of a custom object to a checkpoint directory with a given index
load_custom_state: load the state of a custom object from a checkpoint directory with a given index
save_dataloader_sampler_state: save the sampler state of a dataloader including IterableDatasetShard and stateful dataloader states
